purpose: Generated and placeholder asset manifest for the cozy pixel-art tavern poker UI.

assetPolicy.notes: Generated bitmap assets are local repo files under assets/token-holdem. Null file values mean that asset slot is still pending generation.

layoutContext.shell: Full-page Gradio game scene with tavern-left-rail, poker-stage, tavern-right-rail, action-bar, and bottom-status-panel regions over CSS-rendered tavern background layers.
layoutContext.table: CSS-rendered 16:10 table surface inside the center poker-stage with fixed center HUD and 8 stable seats.
layoutContext.seats: Seat 0 is the human bottom-center seat. Seats 1-7 are LLM seats around the table on desktop and a two-column grid on narrow mobile. Each live seat has avatar, HUD, last-action, card, status, and speech-bubble slots.
layoutContext.controls: Action buttons remain real Gradio controls outside the table art in the bottom action-bar.
layoutContext.liveText: Cards, pot, player names, stacks, action state, and controls are rendered by code and must not be baked into images.

assets.safeArea: Keep the central 54% width and 46% height darker and low-detail so the table, center HUD, cards, and seats stay readable. Avoid key detail near top/bottom HUD margins.
qa: No text, logos, UI screenshots, or playing cards in the background.
Includes stone walls, bar, bartender, shelves, candles, fireplace glow, and quiet central safe zone.
Readable under the existing dark table and seat panels.

assets.safeArea: Table rim must not conflict with seat panels positioned around the ring. Center must stay quiet behind community cards, pot, and street labels.
qa: Transparent edge if floated above a tavern background.
No baked cards, chips, dealer labels, player labels, or pot values.
Works behind the existing center HUD overlay.

assets.safeArea: Must remain legible at 30-34 CSS px near seat positions and not obscure cards or seat status badges.
qa: Single circular chip silhouette with alpha.
Any letter or icon must stay readable at small size.
No baked shadow extending beyond transparent padding.

assets.safeArea: Designed for hidden mini-cards at 24-28 px wide and optional larger card backs at 36-50 px wide.
qa: No rank, suit, readable brand, or watermark.
Rounded rectangle shape matches existing CSS card proportions.
Pattern remains readable when scaled down.

assets.safeArea: Leave a clean inner area for live player name, stack, badges, bet, status, and two mini-card slots.
qa: No baked text or icons that duplicate live status badges.
Edges support compact desktop seats and narrower mobile grid seats.
Active and all-in variants must not rely on color alone.
